    <DataSource>{"DefinitionId":"SqlQuery","Parameters":{"DbConnector":{"Type":"Database","Group":"","EntireGroup":false},"ConnectionString":"","QueryTimeout":"","SqlQuery":";WITH CasierMap AS
(
    SELECT
        LTRIM(RTRIM(CodSucursala)) AS CodSucursala,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(CodPlata)) AS CodPlata,
        MAX(CodCasier) AS CodCasier
    FROM app.CasierPlatitor
    WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(CodSucursala))
        = LTRIM(RTRIM(@CodSucursala))
    GROUP BY
        LTRIM(RTRIM(CodSucursala)),
        LTRIM(RTRIM(CodPlata))
),
Organigrama AS
(
    SELECT
        LTRIM(RTRIM(CodSucursala)) AS CodSucursala,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(CodInferior)) AS CodPlata,
        MAX(
            NULLIF(
                LTRIM(RTRIM(DenumireInferior)),
                ''
            )
        ) AS LocPlata
    FROM app.NomOrganigrama
    WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(CodSucursala))
        = LTRIM(RTRIM(@CodSucursala))
      AND Anul = @Anul
      AND Luna = @Luna
    GROUP BY
        LTRIM(RTRIM(CodSucursala)),
        LTRIM(RTRIM(CodInferior))
),
CarduriRaw AS
(
    SELECT
        'BRD' AS CodBanca,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(CodSucursala)) AS CodSucursala,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(Marca)) AS Marca
    FROM app.CardBRD
    WHERE ISNULL(Valid, 0) = 1
      AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ContIBAN)), '') IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'BT',
        LTRIM(RTRIM(CodSucursala)),
        LTRIM(RTRIM(Marca))
    FROM app.CardBT
    WHERE ISNULL(Valid, 0) = 1
      AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ContIBAN)), '') IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'ING',
        LTRIM(RTRIM(CodSucursala)),
        LTRIM(RTRIM(Marca))
    FROM app.CardING
    WHERE ISNULL(Valid, 0) = 1
      AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ContIBAN)), '') IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'RZB',
        LTRIM(RTRIM(CodSucursala)),
        LTRIM(RTRIM(Marca))
    FROM app.CardRZB
    WHERE ISNULL(Valid, 0) = 1
      AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ContIBAN)), '') IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'BCR',
        LTRIM(RTRIM(CodSucursala)),
        LTRIM(RTRIM(Marca))
    FROM app.CardBCR
    WHERE ISNULL(Valid, 0) = 1
      AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ContIBAN)), '') IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'EXM',
        LTRIM(RTRIM(CodSucursala)),
        LTRIM(RTRIM(Marca))
    FROM app.CardEXM
    WHERE ISNULL(Valid, 0) = 1
      AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ContIBAN)), '') IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'UNI',
        LTRIM(RTRIM(CodSucursala)),
        LTRIM(RTRIM(Marca))
    FROM app.CardUNI
    WHERE ISNULL(Valid, 0) = 1
      AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ContIBAN)), '') IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'CEC',
        LTRIM(RTRIM(CodSucursala)),
        LTRIM(RTRIM(Marca))
    FROM app.CardCEC
    WHERE ISNULL(Valid, 0) = 1
      AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ContIBAN)), '') IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'ALTE',
        LTRIM(RTRIM(CodSucursala)),
        LTRIM(RTRIM(Marca))
    FROM app.CardALTE
    WHERE ISNULL(Valid, 0) = 1
      AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ContIBAN)), '') IS NOT NULL
),
Carduri AS
(
    SELECT
        CodSucursala,
        Marca,
        MAX(CASE WHEN CodBanca = 'BRD'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AreBRD,
        MAX(CASE WHEN CodBanca = 'BT'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AreBT,
        MAX(CASE WHEN CodBanca = 'ING'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AreING,
        MAX(CASE WHEN CodBanca = 'RZB'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AreRZB,
        MAX(CASE WHEN CodBanca = 'BCR'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AreBCR,
        MAX(CASE WHEN CodBanca = 'EXM'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AreEXM,
        MAX(CASE WHEN CodBanca = 'UNI'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AreUNI,
        MAX(CASE WHEN CodBanca = 'CEC'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AreCEC,
        MAX(CASE WHEN CodBanca = 'ALTE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AreALTE
    FROM CarduriRaw
    WHERE CodSucursala = LTRIM(RTRIM(@CodSucursala))
    GROUP BY
        CodSucursala,
        Marca
),
Detaliu AS
(
    SELECT
        cm.CodCasier,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(s.CodPlata)) AS CodPlata,

        COALESCE(
            o.LocPlata,
            N'NECONFIGURAT ÎN ORGANIGRAMĂ'
        ) AS LocPlata,

        v.Suma AS SumaTotala,

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(c.AreBRD, 0) = 1 THEN v.Suma
            ELSE 0
        END AS SumaCardBRD,

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(c.AreBT, 0) = 1 THEN v.Suma
            ELSE 0
        END AS SumaCardBT,

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(c.AreING, 0) = 1 THEN v.Suma
            ELSE 0
        END AS SumaCardING,

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(c.AreRZB, 0) = 1 THEN v.Suma
            ELSE 0
        END AS SumaCardRZB,

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(c.AreBCR, 0) = 1 THEN v.Suma
            ELSE 0
        END AS SumaCardBCR,

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(c.AreEXM, 0) = 1 THEN v.Suma
            ELSE 0
        END AS SumaCardEXM,

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(c.AreUNI, 0) = 1 THEN v.Suma
            ELSE 0
        END AS SumaCardUNI,

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(c.AreCEC, 0) = 1 THEN v.Suma
            ELSE 0
        END AS SumaCardCEC,

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(c.AreALTE, 0) = 1 THEN v.Suma
            ELSE 0
        END AS SumaCardALTE
    FROM app.CalculLichidare cl
    INNER JOIN app.Salariat s
        ON s.Id = cl.IdSalariat
       AND s.CodSucursala = cl.CodSucursala
       AND s.Anul = cl.Anul
       AND s.Luna = cl.Luna
    LEFT JOIN CasierMap cm
        ON cm.CodSucursala = LTRIM(RTRIM(cl.CodSucursala))
       AND cm.CodPlata = LTRIM(RTRIM(s.CodPlata))
    LEFT JOIN Organigrama o
        ON o.CodSucursala = LTRIM(RTRIM(cl.CodSucursala))
       AND o.CodPlata = LTRIM(RTRIM(s.CodPlata))
    LEFT JOIN Carduri c
        ON c.CodSucursala = LTRIM(RTRIM(cl.CodSucursala))
       AND c.Marca = LTRIM(RTRIM(cl.Marca))
    CROSS APPLY
    (
        SELECT
            CAST(
                ISNULL(cl.NetdePlata, 0)
                AS decimal(18, 2)
            ) AS Suma
    ) v
    WHERE cl.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
      AND cl.Anul = @Anul
      AND cl.Luna = @Luna
      -- AND cl.Status = 2
      AND ISNULL(cl.NetdePlata, 0) &gt; 0
),
Centralizat AS
(
    SELECT
        CodCasier,
        CodPlata,
        LocPlata,
        SUM(SumaTotala) AS SumaTotala,
        SUM(SumaCardBRD) AS SumaCardBRD,
        SUM(SumaCardBT) AS SumaCardBT,
        SUM(SumaCardING) AS SumaCardING,
        SUM(SumaCardRZB) AS SumaCardRZB,
        SUM(SumaCardBCR) AS SumaCardBCR,
        SUM(SumaCardEXM) AS SumaCardEXM,
        SUM(SumaCardUNI) AS SumaCardUNI,
        SUM(SumaCardCEC) AS SumaCardCEC,
        SUM(SumaCardALTE) AS SumaCardALTE
    FROM Detaliu
    GROUP BY
        CodCasier,
        CodPlata,
        LocPlata
),
Rezultat AS
(
    SELECT
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER
        (
            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN CodCasier IS NULL THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END,
                CodCasier,
                CodPlata
        ) AS NrCrt,

        CodCasier,
        CodPlata,
        LocPlata,
        SumaTotala,
        SumaCardBRD,
        SumaCardBT,
        SumaCardING,
        SumaCardRZB,
        SumaCardBCR,
        SumaCardEXM,
        SumaCardUNI,
        SumaCardCEC,
        SumaCardALTE
    FROM Centralizat
)
SELECT
    CAST(NrCrt AS int) AS Id,
    CAST(NrCrt AS int) AS NrCrt,
    CodPlata,
    LocPlata,
    CodCasier,
    SumaTotala,
    SumaCardBRD,
    SumaCardBT,
    SumaCardING,
    SumaCardRZB,
    SumaCardBCR,
    SumaCardEXM,
    SumaCardUNI,
    SumaCardCEC,
    SumaCardALTE,

    SumaTotala
        - SumaCardBRD
        - SumaCardBT
        - SumaCardING
        - SumaCardRZB
        - SumaCardBCR
        - SumaCardEXM
        - SumaCardUNI
        - SumaCardCEC
        - SumaCardALTE AS SumaCash,

    CAST('' AS nvarchar(50)) AS Semnatura
FROM Rezultat
ORDER BY
